fieldValues.title: Layers: SRS standard
fieldValues.article_text: The SRS standard's layers are MEANING, EXPRESSION and OPERATION, with the six layer rules, stated in rfc-decision-9ee14517 (refined by 0118e938) and srs/docs/charter/decision-compass.md. This article points there and does not restate them.
fieldValues.rationale: One way per goal: the layer model is stated once, in the srs repository.
